description: This file defines the GrainBasedPubSubRuntime class implementing IStreamPubSub for managing stream publisher-subscriber interactions in Orleans. It handles registration, unregistration, and retrieval of subscriptions, as well as subscription fault handling via grain interface calls.

classes.name: GrainBasedPubSubRuntime
classes.description: Implements IStreamPubSub to handle pub-sub operations for streams in Orleans, utilizing grain factory for rendezvous grain interactions.

methods.name: RegisterProducer
methods.description: Registers a producer for a given stream.

methods.name: UnregisterProducer
methods.description: Unregisters a producer from a given stream.

methods.name: RegisterConsumer
methods.description: Registers a consumer with a subscription ID for a specific stream.

methods.name: UnregisterConsumer
methods.description: Removes a consumer subscription from a stream.

methods.name: ProducerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of producers for a stream.

methods.name: ConsumerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of consumers for a stream.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a stream or specific consumer.

methods.name: CreateSubscriptionId
methods.description: Creates a new unique subscription ID for a consumer.

methods.name: FaultSubscription
methods.description: Faults a subscription, used for error handling or cleanup.
